eu_internal_trade.label: EU Internal Trade
eu_internal_trade.definition: Exporter-reported dispatches where both reporter and partner are EU-27 members; each reported export flow is counted once and mirror import declarations are excluded.

trade_activity.rule: HIGH at volume YoY >= +15%; LOW at <= -15%; otherwise NORMAL. This is descriptive, not a forecast.

unit_value_range.rule: Category-level aggregate for the same completed month; at least 100 tonnes and 2 verified observations with positive net weight and trade value. Review-only, ambiguous and partial-period rows are excluded.
